top_signals.title: Investors cheer end of ‘damaging’ capital gains tax Budget speculation
top_signals.summary: Investment firms have welcomed reports that John Healey has ruled out a “damaging” capital gains tax raid at the Autumn Budget, after warnings the move could harm the domestic economy and weigh on Britain’s appeal to investors.
